title: Avant-Garde Yumeko
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Yumeko becomes fixated on seeing male anatomy and joins her school's art club so she can draw nude portraits, choosing the club's shy boy as her model (Kodansha blurb via AniList; ANN review). The one-volume book by Shuzo Oshimi treats teen sexual curiosity as comedy and coming-of-age, and also includes a separate short story, 'Super Fly' (AniList note).
life_message: Adolescent curiosity is presented as something to pursue openly, though the reviewer notes the boy's discomfort is never resolved.

content.note: ANN mentions physical aggression by Yumeko later in the book; not graphic per review.
